programs.title: Bloomberg Originals
programs.desc: "Bloomberg Originals" offers bold takes for curious minds on today's biggest topics; hosted by experts covering stories you haven't seen and viewpoints you haven't heard, you'll discover cinematic, data-led shows that investigate the intersection of business and culture; exploring every angle of climate change, technology, finance, sports and beyond, "Bloomberg Originals" is business as you've never seen it.

programs.title: Bloomberg Chief Future Officer
programs.desc: Gina Goetter is the CFO and COO of Hasbro; she's the architect of the company's transformation, while diversifying its manufacturing footprint and investing in Hasbro's video game ambitions.

programs.title: Bloomberg Chief Future Officer
programs.desc: Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations; profiling AT&T CFO Pascal Desroches, who has partnered with John Stankey to restructure the company.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Blackstone's Jon Gray on Talent, Loyalty and Building a $1.3 Trillion Wall Street Giant
programs.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Blackstone President Jon Gray; he reflects on leading through crises, highlighting the firm's difficult Hilton deal as a lesson in staying calm, backing strong businesses and thinking long-term; he also emphasizes the importance of resilience, clear decision-making and maintaining humanity in leadership, especially during tough times.

programs.title: The Mishal Husain Show
programs.desc: Mishal Husain brings her signature blend of curiosity and tenacity to weekly conversations with world leaders, business titans and cultural icons, revealing who they really are and how they see the world changing around them.
